title: Prime cyclic detection after forgetting geometric-point coefficients
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative ring, $K$ an algebraically closed field, $X,Y$ schemes, $e:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}K$ and $h:Y\to X$ with $h$ quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. Let $n\ne0$ be a natural number with $n=0$ in $\Lambda$, $q\in\mathbf Z$, and $F$ a sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on $(\operatorname{Spec}K)_{\mathrm{et}}$. If the degree-$q$ base-change target $H^q(Rh_*Le^*(F[0]))$ [sbc-def-base-change-map, def-weil-pbc-direct-image] is nonzero, there is a prime $r\mid n$ which is not a unit in $\Lambda$ and for which $R^qh_*(\underline{P_r/(r)})$ is nonzero, where $P_r=\operatorname{ULift}(\mathbf F_r)$ and the underline denotes the constant sheaf of $P_r$-modules [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf].

proof.text: By exists_constant_module_upperStar_geometricPoint choose a Lambda-module M whose constant sheaf on Y identifies with e-star F. Transport the nonvanishing premise through baseChangeTargetFunctorIso and higherDirectImage of this isomorphism.

Restrict M along the homomorphism from the universe lift of the integers to Lambda. Constant sheaves commute with restriction of scalars, and isZero_higherDirectImage_restrictScalars_iff gives nonvanishing for its constant integer-module sheaf. The relation n=0 in Lambda implies n times every element of M is zero.

Assume there is no requested prime. Apply isZero_higherDirectImage_constant_of_prime_vanishing. For any prime r dividing n with noninjective multiplication on M, r cannot be a unit in Lambda: a unit acts injectively, by scalar cancellation. The assumed absence of a witness therefore forces vanishing of the prime-field constantModSheaf.

In P=ULift(ZMod r), r is zero, hence the ideal it spans is bottom. Submodule.quotEquivOfEqBot identifies the quotient coefficient with P. Transport vanishing through this constant-sheaf isomorphism, then restrict to the integers using isZero_higherDirectImage_restrictScalars_iff. The restricted rank-one P-module is the integer-module P, by Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul. constantCommuteCompose finishes the comparison. Thus every prime required in the previous step vanishes, making the constant M higher direct image zero, a contradiction.
